company-identity.headline: Lock in DiskLordz Audio identity
company-identity.why: Everything else ships under one recognizable brand.
steps: Pick final company string: DiskLordz Audio (confirm spelling).
Write 2-sentence tagline: Built for the Underground + who it's for.
Choose 3 reference colors (dark bg + accent — match PWA lime or revise).
Save logo direction (wordmark only is fine for v1) in a note or Figma.
Drop result in sprint notes or tell audio-business-copilot — mark done in Coach.
company-identity.done_when: You can describe brand in one breath and have colors written down.

dev-environment.headline: Verify your Windows plugin dev box
dev-environment.why: Cursor cannot ship Milestone 001 on a machine that doesn't build.
steps: Install Visual Studio 2022 Community with Desktop development with C++.
Install CMake 3.22+ and add to PATH.
Install JUCE (Projucer or CMake fetch) per your existing Instruments repo docs.
Run: cmake --version, cl.exe or g++ --version — screenshot or log.
Open Cursor only after this passes — delegate Milestone 001 VST shell to Cursor.
dev-environment.done_when: CMake and a C++ compiler run from a normal terminal.

github-repo.headline: Stand up the product repo structure
github-repo.why: DPF layout day-one prevents rewrite when ARP MACHINE ships.
steps: Create private GitHub org/repo OR folder in Instruments per master plan.
Add DPF-Core / DPF-MIDI / Products/ChordEngine folders (empty READMEs OK).
Copy LICENSES/ pattern from master roadmap.
Link repo in audio-command progress notes.
Tell Cursor: implement Milestone 001 in this tree.
github-repo.done_when: Remote exists and DPF folder skeleton matches docs/DPF_TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md.

plugin-skeleton.headline: Delegate: blank VST3 that loads
plugin-skeleton.why: First proof the pipeline works in a DAW.
steps: Open a Cursor agent (VST lane) with docs/DiskLordz_Audio_Master_Roadmap_for_Cursor.md §18 Stage B.
Require: Windows x64 VST3 artifact path + DAW load screenshot.
You only review the agent's build log — do not write C++ yourself unless you want to.
When green, mark done in Coach.
plugin-skeleton.done_when: You have evidence the plugin scans and opens in REAPER or FL.

midi-output.headline: Delegate: MIDI reaches an instrument track
midi-output.why: CHORD ENGINE is a MIDI product — this is the riskiest host behavior.
steps: Cursor task: generate test MIDI from plugin; route to instrument in REAPER.
You: load project, press play once, confirm audible notes.
Log DAW name + buffer size in weekly notes.
Mark done when you heard notes.
midi-output.done_when: Audible MIDI from plugin to instrument without stuck notes in a 30s test.

theory-engine.headline: Delegate: theory unit tests green
theory-engine.why: Musical correctness lives here — not in the UI.
steps: Cursor: Stage D in roadmap — scales, chords, inversions + pytest/ctest.
You: read test summary; spot-check one F minor triad spelling.
Mark done when CI/local tests pass.
theory-engine.done_when: Automated tests exist and pass for scales + triads.

chord-engine.headline: Delegate: extended chord library
steps: Cursor: data-driven chord definitions per roadmap §5.2.
You: pick one maj9 and one min7b5 — confirm notes match your ear in a MIDI monitor.
Mark done.
chord-engine.done_when: Extended chords generate correct MIDI note sets in tests.

progression-generator.headline: Delegate: 4-chord progression generator
steps: Cursor: F minor + Dark Trap example from PRD.
You: export MIDI, import to DAW, listen once.
Mark done.
progression-generator.done_when: Four-chord progression exports and loops in DAW.

first-interface.headline: Delegate: key + grid UI wired to engine
steps: Cursor: five UI areas — only wire controls that work.
You: 10-minute usability pass at 100% scale on your monitor.
Mark done.
first-interface.done_when: You can change key and see progression update without crash.

first-alpha.headline: Package first alpha zip
steps: Cursor produces signed/unsigned build folder.
You: zip VST3 + README with version 0.1.0-alpha.
Back up to cloud storage.
Mark done — celebrate.
first-alpha.done_when: Alpha zip stored and path noted in weekly review.
